let d = document.documentElement.classList
d.remove('t_light')
d.remove('t_dark')
let e = null
try { e = localStorage.getItem('vxrn-scheme') } catch (_e) {}
let t = 'system' === e || !e
  ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
  : e === 'dark'
t ? d.add('t_dark') : d.add('t_light')
